english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the activity or profession of teaching.
Use this when the coaching is framed as teaching or instruction, especially in an educational setting.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for teaching or educational instruction.
Use this for the teaching or instruction provided by a teacher, not the fee or the private class itself.
